prompt_verbatim: Revise the first image as one complete side-view pixel art frame of Ultraman Type C, for the moment his descending body first meets the monster's back. The composite reference 2 shows the current problem: with pelvis held in the correct place the abdomen falls short of the back. Keep the pelvis in the same place, but bend forward at the hips noticeably more, bring chest and abdomen forward RIGHT until lower abdomen can meet the back, while keeping the head above and left of the horns. Knees bend and draw upward slightly, without changing pelvis position or making him horizontal yet: the later pose is reference 3. Arms remain both connected, bent back by his sides, clear of the belly and horns; exactly two hands, two feet, and natural proportions. Match reference 4 red-silver identity and blue chest light. Output ONLY full isolated character on transparent background, no monster, no other figures, no glow, text, shadow or border. Preserve cohesive crisp 2D pixel art.
